docs.title: Glowtape
docs.text:
Welcome to the Glowtape user guide.

Glowtape is an ambient 64×64 LED display that recognizes music and displays album artwork, alongside weather, arcade games and other display modes.

docs.title: 1.0.4-beta.2 - Oct 10 2026
docs.text:
• Added ocean mode (screensaver)
  • Added multi-game Arcade mode
  • Added Breakout style game
  • Added Tetris style game
  • Added Space Invaders style game
  • Added Lunar Lander style game
  • Added game selection and game-specific phone controls
  • Added autonomous attract-mode rotation
  • Improved Arcade controller responsiveness
  • Fixed Arcade control visibility and initialization issues

docs.title: 1.0.4-beta.1 - Sep 6 2026
docs.text:
• Handle weather service failures gracefully
  • Catch Open-Meteo request and API errors
  • Add weather error condition and fallback icon
  • Display ? when temperature data is unavailable
  • Hide feels-like and precipitation data on failure
  • Preserve time and date during weather outages
  • Fall back to white clock display in Layout 2
  • Automatically recover on the next successful weather refresh

  • Harden OTA updates and runtime permissions

  • Standardize Glowtape application ownership

  • Prevent root-owned Python bytecode in the app directory
  • Make platform state safely readable by the pi user
  • Enforce app ownership after install and rollback
  • Add platform-aware OTA health checks
  • Allow startup time for platform migrations
  • Capture service diagnostics on failed updates
  • Back up platform files and migration state before updates
  • Restore previous platform files during rollback
  • Remove platform files introduced by failed migrations
  • Restore platform state after failed updates
  • Reload systemd after platform rollback
  • Verify automatic recovery from application startup failures
  • Verify automatic recovery from failed platform migrations

docs.title: 1.0.3-beta.3 - Jul 10 2026
docs.text: • Fixed hardcoded timezone, so now time will be correct in all timezones.
